deployment_procedure: 2. Seed ref_currency with ISO 4217 currency codes
3. Seed tenant_tier with tier definitions (Starter/Professional/Enterprise etc.)
4. Seed tenant table with UUIDs matching all tenant_id values in V001-V009 data
5. Seed auth_user with UUIDs matching all created_by/approved_by values
6. Seed agent_identity with UUIDs matching all agent_id values
7. Apply V011 — FK constraints will validate against seed data

cross_agent_integration_points.integration: Allocated cost records are the primary source for all downstream cost analysis
Confirmed anomalies trigger forecast re-generation per FSD FC-007
Budget state uses forecast points for projected exhaustion date
Conflicting recommendations from multiple optimizers flow to cr_conflict.conflicting_entity_refs JSONB
A24 is a specialized sub-agent of A20; shares gov_severity and gov_policy_scope enums
Statement line items trace back to raw allocation and rating records

cross_agent_integration_points.producer: All agents with models (V005, V012, V013, V017-V020, V024)
cross_agent_integration_points.integration: cl_model_registry tracks all agent model versions; cl_feedback_signal captures human responses to any agent's output
au_audit_event aggregates events from every domain via event_category + actor_type + target_entity_type
ps_setting_value provides hierarchical config (Platform Default → Tenant Override → User Override → Environment Override) replacing hardcoded agent settings

risks_and_gotchas.issue: V011 FK backfill fails on empty foundation
risks_and_gotchas.mitigation: Populate tenant/auth_user/agent_identity seed data before running V011

risks_and_gotchas.issue: ref_currency must exist before applying V007+
risks_and_gotchas.mitigation: Seed ref_currency with ISO 4217 codes as part of V006 post-migration script

risks_and_gotchas.issue: Partitioned tables need ongoing partition creation
risks_and_gotchas.mitigation: Use pg_partman or scheduled job to create next month partitions. V006-V023 only create partitions for 2026-07 and 2026-08 as examples

risks_and_gotchas.issue: RLS policies require app.current_tenant_id session variable
risks_and_gotchas.mitigation: Application layer must SET app.current_tenant_id before every query, typically in middleware
Use app.is_platform_admin session variable or superuser role for cross-tenant queries

risks_and_gotchas.issue: Cross-migration enum dependencies (opt_* from V015, gov_* from V014) require strict ordering
risks_and_gotchas.mitigation: Flyway/Liquibase numerical ordering enforces this; do not skip migrations
